auftrag: Read the email from Agent Wren. Then solve four puzzles.

saetze: You are one of our new trainees.
Please come to the Agent Academy tomorrow at nine o'clock.
Meet me in the Map Room on the second floor.
Bring your ID card and this email.
Please do not tell anybody about the Academy.
Something important is missing, and we need your help.

raetsel.frage: When must the trainees come to the Academy?
raetsel.hilfe2: The time is in the second sentence of the first paragraph.

raetsel.frage: True or false? “The Map Room is on the first floor.”
raetsel.hilfe1: Find the sentence about the Map Room.
raetsel.hilfe2: Is it the first floor or the second floor?
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that tells you what to bring.
raetsel.hilfe2: It is the first sentence of the third paragraph.

raetsel.frage: Read the short message. Choose the right words.
raetsel.text: Hi! I ___ a new trainee. Tomorrow I ___ to the Academy. Yesterday I ___ the email.
raetsel.hilfe1: Look at the time words: Tomorrow, Yesterday.
raetsel.hilfe2: "I" goes with "am". Yesterday means it is finished.
